title: Rule package harness: repository, SIT environment, seeding, evidence format and gate are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 s12 and s13 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 13, 14, 20, 27, 41, 42 and 44; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 15 and 16; legacy RWB-E2-042 sections 3, 12, 13 and 15
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow step 12; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan
description: No source read gives the harness repository, the SIT environment it runs in, the seeding set for the three package versions and the two payment cases, the evidence format and its retention, the pass or fail gate, or the exact response values of the five fakes. The three package codes, the three version labels, the row counts 38, 3 and 21, the scenario counts 62, 58 and 54, the valid from 2026-12-15, the business date 2026-12-10, the loader U-41 and approver U-51, rules.testcases.min 50, R-RES-26 with EXACT, WINDOW and PARTIAL, the two payments, R-RES-04's three fields and case RW-2026-000777 are all given by the legacy story; only the harness mechanics are absent.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-042 section 3 lists the preconditions of the packages and the users but no harness environment, no seeding set and no evidence; section 12 gives the load, version-list and approve contracts with their error codes but no fake response body; section 13 lists the components, the migrations and the workbooks but no repository and no gate; section 15 states 'No screen in this story' with no read model for a run report. Architecture v5 slide 27 and Temporal and Drools design slide 15 fix governance in rwb-decision and local evaluation in the owning service, and product the events, but name no harness environment. ownership.json gives owners, tables, events and operations only.
proposed: The integration lead agrees the harness repository, the SIT environment, the seeding set for the three versions and the two payment cases, the per-run evidence format and its retention, the pass or fail gate and the fake response bodies with the rwb-decision and rwb-payment owners and QA at the wave 2 entry check; the values are held as data in the harness pack, not in the story.

title: Reference workflow harness repository and SIT environment, seeding, evidence format and gate are not specified, and the ownership map holds no rwb-case outbox delivery read
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 13, 14, 18, 20, 41, 42 and 44; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 11 to 16 and 27 to 28; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json; legacy RWB-E2-043 sections 3, 12 and 13
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan
description: No source read gives the harness repository and its SIT environment, the seeding set and script for the synthetic case and the two RESTRUCTURE versions, the evidence format of a run and its retention, or the pass or fail gate of a wave 2 integration run; it also gives no exact response values for the rwb-case, rwb-decision, rwb-source-data and case-event fakes. The ownership map holds no outbox delivery read for rwb-case, so the retry of a failed signal can only be asserted through the absence of the effect and the same event key on rwb.case.events.v1.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives owners, tables, events, workflows and operations only, and its outbox reads sit with P2 rwb-integration (GET /admin/outbox/deliveries), not with P3 rwb-case
proposed: The integration lead agrees the harness repository, the SIT environment, the seeding set and its script, the per-run evidence format and its retention, and the pass or fail gate with QA at the wave 2 entry check, and confirms the fake answers from the published OpenAPI documents and event schemas; the missing rwb-case outbox delivery read is either added to the rwb-case contract by RWB-P3-E2043-APP or the retry stays asserted through the effect and the event key, and the choice is recorded before the harness is declared Done.

title: The harness repository, the SIT environment, the seeding set, the evidence format and retention, the pass or fail gate and the exact fake responses for RWB-ITG-E3006-ITG are named by no read source
source: Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1 §R7.3, §R9 and §R5.5 DP-05 and DP-07; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md heading RWB-E3-006; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3.md FEAT-TRT-06; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md R-SET-01; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Program v4.md sections 5.1, 5.7 and 5.9; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json
section: 3. Preconditions; 4. Flow; 6. INVEST check; 11. Data; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13. Solution plan; 15. Screens and states; 16. Test cases; 17. Guardrails
description: The legacy key states the behaviour but none of the run material around it. No read source names: the harness repository and its pipeline; the SIT environment the criterion runs in; the seeding set for the case at ROUTE_APPROVED_SETTLEMENT, its settlement treatment and the ALS payoff facts, including the account or accounts it uses; the data product code that carries the ALS payoff facts through the P1 products contract; the list code that carries the range through the P3 reference-data contract; the evidence report format and its retention; the pass or fail gate that decides the wave entry check; and the exact response values, status codes and result codes of the five WireMock fakes. The rule table names the action and the states but not the range values, the freshness limit or the record fields the harness must see, so the harness reads them from the owners rather than asserting literals. The story carries the working read of the assumption instead: one harness runner, five contract stubs pinned to their published versions, one event probe, one report per business date, SIT only, seeding through published operations only, and RWB-S2-E3006-APP as the owner of the behaviour once it lands.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E3-006 (heading, acceptance criteria AC1 to AC3, Data table, Endpoints table, Test cases TC-E3-006-01 to TC-E3-006-05) and Feature FEAT-TRT-06 give behaviour, entities, field IDs and two monolith endpoints only; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-SET-01 gives the route set, the from and to states, the condition and the action, no value; Business Requirements Program v4 sections 5.1, 5.7 and 5.9 give REQ-RDF-002, REQ-DRI-001, REQ-DRI-005 and REQ-S2-004 as requirements, no run material; Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-05 and DP-07 name the contracts but not a product code or a list code; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json holds GET /data-products/{productCode}/records under P1 and GET /admin/lists/{listCode} under P3, with the ruling that reference data stays with P3, and names no code for either; no read source names the seeding set, the SIT environment, the evidence format or its retention, the gate or a fake response value.
owner_role: QA lead with the integration lead and the data product owner (P1 rwb-source-data, P3 rwb-case)
proposed: Agree the harness repository, the SIT environment and the seeding set at the wave 2 entry check; name the P1 data product code for the ALS payoff facts and the P3 list code for the range in the contract registry; fix the evidence report shape, its retention and the pass or fail gate in the wave entry checklist; generate the five stubs from the published contracts and pin their versions in the run report.

title: NLEADS and ALS interface detail, harness environment, seeding set and evidence gate for RWB-E3-010 are not specified
source: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 16 and 41 (P2 owns interface config, file runs, outbound items), slide 43 (FileDelivered, FileFailed) and slide 44 (JOB-08 booking confirmation, rwb-payment); Business Requirements Program v4 sections 5.2 and 5.9; legacy RWB-E3-010
section: Template and Rules v1, R7.3 fill order items 1 to 6: no legacy story, module specification, BRD or arch slide gives the interface detail, the harness environment, the seeding set, the evidence format or the pass or fail gate
description: The legacy key names NLEADS and ALS as the systems the agreed plan leaves to, and its endpoint table lists one treatment read. No source in the fill order gives the NLEADS or ALS interface code, transport, message or file layout, test endpoint or result code mapping; nor the harness repository and SIT environment, the seeding set for the treatment, the plan and the booking facts, the evidence report format and its retention, or the pass or fail gate that admits the wave. The harness story therefore carries the interface detail as ASM-B-ITG-W2-08-E3010-2 and the environment, seeding, evidence and gate as ASM-B-ITG-W2-08-E3010-1, and names both in the story rather than inventing any value.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E3-010 in the Epics 3 to 8 story master: acceptance criteria name NLEADS and ALS through the outbound interface and v_ace_account, v_ace_payment and v_ace_plan, and the endpoints table lists only GET /api/recovery/v1/treatments/{treatmentId}. Arch v5 slide 16 gives rwb-integration the interface config, file runs and outbound items but names neither NLEADS nor ALS; slide 43 lists FileDelivered and FileFailed without a layout; slide 44 lists JOB-08 booking confirmation with no file or endpoint. No FSD or TSD module extract, Program BRD requirement or Business Rules row gives an interface code, transport, layout or test endpoint.
area: Integration testing and the NLEADS and ALS outbound interfaces
owner_role: Integration lead with the QA lead
proposed: Fix the NLEADS and ALS interface codes, transports, message or file layouts and test endpoints with the P2 interface owners at the wave 2 entry check; fix the harness repository, the SIT environment, the seeding set, the evidence format and retention and the pass or fail gate with the QA lead. Carry all of them as harness configuration, never as business values in code, and attach the agreed values to this gap before the story is reported Done.

title: The CCMS and Land Office check interface, the harness environment and seeding set, the fake response values and the evidence and gate of the early readiness harness are not in the sources
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E3-013); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3.md (FEAT-TRT-13, FEAT-TRT-12); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Program v4.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md (R-DIL-01, R-SET-22); 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md
description: No source names the early encumbrance and title check interface the Workbench uses with CCMS and the Land Office, its codes, its transport or layout, its test endpoint or the fixture result codes; nor the harness repository and its SIT environment; nor the seeding set that places the case at ROUTE_APPROVED_DIL with its deed-in-lieu treatment and the second case at COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED with its title documents missing, including the identifiers of the cases, the treatments and the accounts; nor the exact response values of the six fakes of section 12.8; nor the evidence report format and its retention; nor the pass or fail gate the wave entry check reads.
evidence: RWB-E3-013 gives one endpoint (GET /api/recovery/v1/treatments/{treatmentId}), four screens of state names and six messages, and no interface detail; FEAT-TRT-13 names CCMS and the Land Office as the systems and gives no operation, code or layout; the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIL-01 and R-SET-22 give the from state, the event, the condition, the action, the to state, the owner, the systems and the timer and no protocol; Architecture v5 slide 41 gives the service catalogue and its topics, and slide 14, 15 and 18 give the P3, P1, P7, P4 and S2 contracts, and no check interface; the ownership map gives no CCMS or Land Office operation and no harness operation.
proposed: Name one check interface with its codes and its fixture result set; fix one SIT harness environment and its repository; publish one seeding set of two cases with their treatments, accounts and asset keys and the exact response values of the six fakes; fix the evidence report shape, its retention and one pass or fail gate keyed by story and business date; keep every value in configuration, never in code.
